target.purpose: Compile multi-sensor detections into bounded spatiotemporal envelopes that preserve stale-evidence decay, geometric uncertainty, independent-sensor authority, and residual unknown mass.
current_mechanisms: half-life temporal decay at an explicit reference time
diagonal covariance expansion with age-dependent growth
per-sensor centroid refinement without report-count authority multiplication
independent-sensor known-mass fusion and explicit residual unknown mass
backward-compatible Python and native C interfaces
target.next_bottleneck: off-diagonal covariance is not yet converted into rotated envelope geometry; the compiler also lacks motion prediction, outlier-gated fusion, and durable append-only fusion receipts

invariants: empty evidence cannot create a track envelope
stale evidence loses support instead of remaining timelessly authoritative
one sensor cannot manufacture independent known mass through repeated reports
residual unknown mass remains visible unless evidence actually reaches certainty
repository identity and lineage remain preserved
nonclaims: no Anduril affiliation or production tracking deployment
covariance_xy is validated in Python but is not yet used to rotate axis-aligned bounds
native C currently represents diagonal covariance only
no motion-model prediction or outlier-gated fusion yet
no durable append-only fusion receipt chain yet
